compose_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs and verify the resulting graph structure
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a graph to get the log-sum-exp of all path weights
find_viterbi_path: find the highest-scoring path through a weighted graph using the Viterbi algorithm
concatenate_graphs: concatenate multiple graphs in sequence to build a chained transducer pipeline
remove_epsilon_arcs: remove epsilon transitions from a graph to produce an equivalent epsilon-free graph
